serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
???: Dreamfish, is that right? 
You: Yes! Do you know it?
???: I got a stash of some shit like that from some European guy. He was dealing it in Prague, tried going global, but he up and died. 
You: Whatever! How much?
???: That shit? Damn, I can give it to you for free, pale boy. I wanted to flush it down the toilet, but that shit so strong I was afraid I would kill half the city.
???: Here you go, but be careful. This is a straight-up brain melter. Take too much and it’s over. You are one weird-looking motherfucker, but I wouldn’t want to have you on my conscience. 
You: Sure, sure~
???: You crazy. Now get the hell out of here. And smoke it far away from here. I don’t want no trouble.
Yes! Finally! I got my hands on this stuff! 
Now I only need to find a place to smoke it.
